name: Sage-A1.5
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from Qwen/Qwen3.6-35B-A3B (config.json max_position_embeddings 262144). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
attention_variant: Inherited unchanged from Qwen/Qwen3.6-35B-A3B: 10 full GQA layers (kv heads 2, head_dim 256) and 30 other layers, per the base config.json.
notes: ADDED 2026-10-22 from the HF API trending feed. A post-train, not a new base: HF repo created 2026-10-15, safetensors total 35,951,822,704 BF16 - byte-identical parameter set to models/qwen3-6-35b-a3b, and the config model_type qwen3_5_moe_text plus vision_config (27-layer, 1152-hidden, patch 16) match the Qwen3.6-35B-A3B VLM config. BASE CAVEAT: the card says it is built on BOTH Qwen3.6-35B-A3B and InternScience/Agents-A1, and prints an Agents-A1 column beside its own. Agents-A1 is not a catalog record, so the tool's base_model is the tagged Qwen repo; the base-vs-tuned delta that the card actually claims (+17.6 SWE-bench Pro, +14.0 SWE-bench Multilingual, +13.1 PinchBench, +21.3 MLE-Lite vs Agents-A1) is against Agents-A1, not against Qwen3.6. active_params_b is INHERITED from the base record's 3.0 (routed 8 of 256 experts); it is not restated on the Sage card, which only says '~35B model class'. Independent check of the text config: 40 layers x (8 routed x 512 x 2048 x 3 + shared 512 x 2048 x 3) = 1.132e9, plus 10 full-attention layers at 18.87e6 and 30 linear-attention layers at ~29.4e6 and one 248,320 x 2048 output head, totals ~2.7e9 active - consistent with 3.0e9 rounded, so the inherited figure is not contradicted. kv_cache_bytes_per_token = 10 full_attention layers (layer_types puts one every 4th) x 2 kv heads x 256 head_dim x 2 (K and V) x 2 bytes = 20,480 B/token. The other 30 layers are linear_attention with a constant-size state, so they add no per-token KV. flops_per_token_active reads 18.0e9 = 6 x 3.0e9, following the existing derivative records (clef, d1-3b) and the 3x-multiply-and-add convention; the 2N one-pass estimate would be 6.0e9. It is an approximation, not a measurement. LOSES, printed by the card itself: GAIA 95.1 vs Agents-A1 96.0, MatTools 42.6 vs 47.1, HiPhO 45.3 vs 46.4. All rows are vendor claims, marked vendor_claim; the SWE rows are footnoted (mini-SWE-agent, temp 1.0, top-p 0.95, 200K ctx, offline) but the non-SWE rows print no harness. Hardware gate: 35.95B total, 3.0B active, 8 of 256 experts routed, BF16 checkpoint ~72 GB - runs here with expert offload only. GATED? No, repo is public (gated=False).

benchmarks.name: IFBench
benchmarks.config: Card HTML table, column 'Sage-A1.5'. Class-best in catalog was spark-x2-6-4b 75.8 (its own card does not pin a thinking level) and motif-3 78.2 (314B, not this class). Harness not restated for IFBench; card only footnotes the SWE series (mini-SWE-agent, temp 1.0, top-p 0.95, 200K ctx, offline).

benchmarks.name: BrowseComp
benchmarks.config: Card prints two values: 81.7 w/o Agentic Orchestration and 82.8 w/ it. This row is the orchestrated number, which needs the card's opt-in subagent harness; the plain single-agent number is 81.7. Class-best in catalog was bigbang-v1 76.5 and ornith-1-5-122b 78.5 (9.3B active, outside this class).

benchmarks.name: SWE-bench Pro
benchmarks.config: mini-SWE-agent harness, temperature 1.0, top-p 0.95, 200K-token context, automatic context compaction, fully offline (card footnote). Class-best before this was spark-x2-6-4b 54.3. Beats Agents-A1 43.6 and Ornith-1.5 59.6 in the same table; loses to Kimi-K3 63.3 and GLM-5.3 64.6.
